📤 **Upload ticket ready**

**Step 1 ✅ Done** — you called file_upload and got the presigned URL.

**Step 2 — Upload file bytes now** (choose your shell; Git Bash uses Windows curl for Unicode filenames when available):
```bash
curl -sS -w '%{http_code}' -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: application/octet-stream' -T 'K:\Fluxgroup\FluxGroup\quant\bigmoney\_r944_upload_test.txt' 'https://tuanjie-ai-prd.tos-cn-shanghai.volces.com/mcp-upload/523922a433768a929417eb52f71c4afa/_r944_upload_test.txt?X-Tos-Algorithm=TOS4-HMAC-SHA256&X-Tos-Credential=AKLT__REDACTED__-shanghai%2Ftos%2Frequest&X-Tos-Date=20261012T150349Z&X-Tos-Expires=3600&X-Tos-Signature=__REDACTED__&X-Tos-SignedHeaders=host'
```
```powershell
curl.exe -sS -w '%{http_code}' -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: application/octet-stream' -T 'K:\Fluxgroup\FluxGroup\quant\bigmoney\_r944_upload_test.txt' 'https://tuanjie-ai-prd.tos-cn-shanghai.volces.com/mcp-upload/523922a433768a929417eb52f71c4afa/_r944_upload_test.txt?X-Tos-Algorithm=TOS4-HMAC-SHA256&X-Tos-Credential=AKLT__REDACTED__-shanghai%2Ftos%2Frequest&X-Tos-Date=20261012T150349Z&X-Tos-Expires=3600&X-Tos-Signature=__REDACTED__&X-Tos-SignedHeaders=host'
```
Expected final HTTP status: `200`. On failure, retain the storage JSON error body (RequestId, Code, EC) printed before the status.

If PUT returns HTTP 403, wait at least 1 second before calling `file_upload` again with the same `file_path`, then retry the bytes upload **once** with the new ticket. Reissuing within the same second can return the same signature. If the refreshed result says `already_uploaded=true`, use its `file_url` without another PUT. If the second PUT fails, stop and retain the storage RequestId/error code; do not use the unconfirmed file as a generation reference.

**Step 3 — Use file_url in generate_* tools:**
- `file_url`: `https://tuanjie-ai-prd.tos-cn-shanghai.volces.com/mcp-upload/523922a433768a929417eb52f71c4afa/_r944_upload_test.txt`
- Pass this as `image_url` (for generate_3d_model), `image_urls` (for generate_image, generate_video, generate_skybox, generate_sprite_animation), `screenshot_url` (for generate_game_ui_kit), `model_url` (for unirig_rig or convert_3d_model), or `url` (for tripo_mesh_segmentation, tripo_texture_model, tripo_decimate)
